verdict.rationale: Cekura ships official Skills and an MCP server so an AI assistant can design, run, and improve voice-agent evaluations from natural-language requests. A dedicated guide covers using it from Claude Code, Cursor, and VS Code Copilot, and the docs show a natural-language prompt workflow ("create a comprehensive plan to integrate cekura observability"). The GitHub skills plugin bundles 13 skills and 14 commands. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language command interface (operation goes through third-party AI assistants), detail on which product operations the skills and MCP tools cover, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the natural-language workflow.
